candidate.title: Adds a new configuration option - `tenantID` - for the AzureDNS provider when using managed identities with service principals
candidate.text: Adds a new configuration option - `tenantID` - for the AzureDNS provider when using managed identities with service principals. This enhancement allows users to specify the tenant ID when using managed identities, offering better flexibility in multi-tenant environments. (#7376, @jochenrichter)
